lines: Meanwhileー
The outskirts of Gosha Village.
On a country road running through a vast field.
There were two figures just outside the Gosha barrier, which was invisible to ordinary people.
Shonosuke
Are you sure this is where he was headed?
The man's long, beautiful hair flowed like silver thread, and his features were so refined that he could be mistaken for a woman.
He wore such a graceful air that even the scorching summer sun seemed to avoid him.
He was Gaku Shonosuke, a user of the extremely swift Battojutsu that specialized in "Falcon Jutsu."
Saburo
Daigoro's sense of smell is 3,000 times better than a dog's. I'm sure of it.
The one who'd answered in a slightly irritated tone was Onigumo Saburo, a girl in a school uniform who likewise had delicate, snow-white features that seemed divorced from the summer heat.

The girl was perched on the back of a giant demonic spider she'd called Daigoro. Its body was covered with a menacing-looking outer shell that looked as if it'd been directly carved out of basalt with a sharp chisel.
At first glance, she had innocent features like a daughter of a noble family, but her eyes were eerily glowing red just like the many eyes of the demonic spider.
Shonosuke
This is the worst-case scenario for us.
Saburo
Why?
Shonosuke
Because beyond this point is Gosha territory.
Shonosuke answered, making a face as if to say, "Isn't that obvious?"
If they took even one step further than where they stood, they would be in Gosha's territory.
If it came to light that the underbosses of Nisha had invaded Gosha's territory, it would inevitably create an uproar.
Saburo
I'm aware.
Saburo put on a curious face as if to say, "So what?"
Saburo
I'm just here to carry out my mission.
Shonosuke
And you will. But if we're seen by the Gosha Taimianin, the mission would be the last of our concerns.
Saburo
It'll be fine if it's just me and Daigoro. We can stay hidden while we move.
Shonosuke
Shonosuke breathed such a faint sigh that Saburo wouldn't notice it.
Shonosuke
I can't move through the dirt like you can.
Saburo
That's why you'll wait here, Sho-nii. Let's go, Daigoro.
Saburo gave a couple of pats on the demonic spider's back.
Daigoro
*SKREE!*
The spider's legs, which looked like sharpened rocks, simultaneously began to move and dug a hole into the ground.
Shonosuke
Wait, Saburo!!!
Uncharacteristically flustered, Shonosuke called out to stop Saburo,
but in the blink of an eye, the demon spider disappeared into the earth with Saburo on its back.
Shonosuke
Saburo!? Just make sure you avoid combat! Our mission is only to bring "him" back!
Saburo
『I know. Okay, I'm off.』
A muffled voice came back from within the earth.
Saburo was about to infiltrate enemy territory, but she sounded as if she were just going for a little walk.
Shonosuke
If somebody sees you, we're withdrawing! Do you understand!?
Her reply no longer came back.
And, as if nothing had ever happened, the ground returned to its previous state leaving no trace of the giant spider having burrowed into it.
Shonosuke
Oh dear...
The lone Shonosuke let out a deep sigh.
Shonosuke
Stealth is not my forte, but I've got no choice...
And with that, Shonosuke set foot in Gosha territory, following after Saburo.
